idea: Use a scipy-milp exact partition of an L×L integer board (L from ⌈√n⌉ to 3⌈√n⌉ within a time budget) into at most n axis-aligned integer squares. Binary variables x[i,j,s] place a square of side s at (i,j). Cover each cell at most once, require Σx = n, and maximise Σ s·x / L. Warm-start from the best closed-form answer and stop each L after a few seconds.
